findings.issue: Frozen tests depend on unindexed historical data files under goals/autonomous-software-v1/evidence/ (gemini-stream-surface, component-review-03/04, native-surface-01, controller-codex-effective-features). Those bytes are not in SOURCE INDEX bindings or registration_source_names, and verify_runtime_sources only checks imported modules, not Path.read_text data reads. Controls therefore are not reproducible from the frozen index alone.
findings.required_change: Bind every evidence file read by frozen tests into registration_source_names/source_sha256, or make those tests hermetic with inline fixtures and remove goals/ reads; extend closure check to fail on unbound data-file reads.

findings.issue: Contract requires any argv including --help to error before reading stdin, but the single argv oracle uses empty stdin. A programme that reads stdin first then checks argv still passes, so ordering clause is untested and unenforceable from this oracle.
findings.required_change: Change format-argv to use non-empty otherwise-legal stdin (e.g. legal receive line) with argv=[--help] expecting invalid_input, or add a second argv-with-payload recipe; document that empty-stdin argv alone does not prove before-read ordering.

review.oracle_audit: Audited 73/73 declared oracles against contract.md: legal 11/11 correct including empty, transfer with key-order duplicate, whitespace/CRLF, balance beyond 1e9, no-final-LF; identity 10/10 correct including validate-before-id, depletion idempotence, bool/float conflicts; order 10/10 correct including no transient overdraw and future-credit; types 13/13 correct including 64-byte unicode, NUL/CR/LF escapes, surrogate, invalid UTF-8, raw NUL; format 10/10 correct framing; boundaries 19/19 correct including id/lot/site/from/to 64/65, 65536/65537 bytes, 1000/1001 events, metamorphic duplicates/bijection, empty strings. Judge enforces strict JSON, duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, bool/float quantity types, exact error bytes, exit codes, and timeout/truncation as fail with infrastructure as inconclusive. Original60 canonical SHA be25952e519f52a32947861737ae5fd7b8a53819ba34a0f4c5cf7bbff210fe61 preservation test binds every ID/input/argv/expected. Finite corpus remains non-exhaustive by design; argv-ordering and unbound test fixtures above are the remaining concrete gaps.
review.rationale: Sources fix prior review10 items: exact /input/delivery/lotledger.py invocation in contract/subjects/native transport, fences rejected, original60 bytes bound, comparison draft excluded, uid1000 receipts for both images. Two concrete pre-freeze gaps remain: unbound historical evidence reads breaking import/data closure, and argv-before-stdin oracle using empty stdin. No nine-phase generation, no F73/73/D8/8/M6/6, no baselines or field claims; those remain post-generation gates. Later multitype N/S/T ablation and release/publication require a separate frozen comparison protocol and are not admitted by this review.
